fields.YourDetailsInstruction: Please provide the policyholder's contact details and policy information. If you are claiming on behalf of someone else, select your relationship to the policyholder. All required fields are marked with an asterisk.
fields.WhatHappenedInstructions: Tell us what happened, when it happened, and where the incident took place. Accurate details help us process your claim more efficiently. If a crime was involved, please include any police reference number.
fields.IncidentDetailsDescription: Tell us what and when the incident happened so we can assess your claim.
fields.DateOfLossFieldInfo: Enter the date the incident or loss occurred. If unsure, use your best estimate.
fields.IncidentTypeFieldInfo: Select the category that best describes what happened to your item or property.
fields.ReportedToPolice: Was this theft reported to the police?
fields.HowDidItHappenFieldInfo: Describe the incident, including what happened, where it occurred, and any important details that may help us assess your claim. Maximum 500 characters.
fields.WhereDidThisHappenDescription: Select where the loss occurred, whether at your registered address, on deployment, during an exercise, or at another location.
fields.US_PCFormatErrMsg: Enter a valid US zip code
fields.ItemsAffectedInstruction: List each item you are claiming for, including a description, age, purchase price, and replacement cost. Adding as much detail as possible will help us assess your claim quickly and fairly.
fields.ItemCoverTypeFieldInfo: Select the category of cover that applies to this item under your policy
fields.ItemTypeFieldInfo: Select the specific type of item you are claiming for.
fields.ClaimedAmountFieldInfo: Enter the amount you are claiming. This should reflect the current replacement value, not the original purchase price.
fields.ItemDescPH: Dell Latitude 5520 Laptop, 15.6", Intel Core i5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
fields.PurchasePriceFieldInfo: The original price you paid for this item.
fields.AddNewItemDescription: Enter the details of the item you're claiming for. Accurate information helps us assess your claim more quickly.
fields.EditItemDescription: Update the details of this item. Accurate information helps us assess your claim more quickly.
fields.SavedItemsDescription: Review, edit, or remove items you've added.
fields.EvidenceInstruction:
Upload documents or photos that support your claim.

fields.FPNText: To help protect our customers and prevent fraud, we may use the information you provide to verify your identity, review claims history and carry out checks with fraud prevention agencies, Insurers, public records and other relevant organisations. We may also share information with these organisations where appropriate and receive information from them.
fields.FPNText2: These checks help us verify policy and claim information and support the prevention and detection of fraud.
